name: website-template
description: Reusable static website template — Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 + Sveltia CMS on Netlify

comments.overrides: sharp is an unused OPTIONAL dep of Next. Route (a) sends all image optimisation to the Netlify Image CDN, so sharp never executes. It cannot be surgically omitted (--omit=optional also strips required lightningcss/swc native binaries), so we pin it to the patched latest to clear the libvips CVE advisories. Re-audit and drop this pin once Next's own sharp floor moves past it.
